result.finding: Estimated final image size of approximately 280-350MB based on eclipse-temurin:8-jre base (~220MB) plus Spring Boot fat JAR (~80-120MB). Multi-stage build prevents Maven/build tools from inflating the final image.
evidence: Final stage base image: eclipse-temurin:8-jre (Debian-based JRE, ~220MB)
No additional apt-get/apk package installations in Dockerfile
Spring Boot fat JAR bundles all dependencies (spring-boot-starter-web, data-jpa, thymeleaf, ojdbc8) — estimated 80-120MB
Source code is minimal (324KB), size dominated by bundled dependencies in JAR
Multi-stage build: Maven build stage (~700MB) discarded; only JAR copied to final stage
values: Spring Boot fat JAR (application + all dependencies): ~80-120MB
